rationale: P characterises vehicle braking, the behaviour directly at issue in H-3 and SG-3, within the hazard's stated operational context. FR-7 establishes obstacle-avoidance braking as an intended-braking case against which unintended braking can be distinguished. This remains a characterisation of braking behaviour, not an expansion into the observation, computation, control implementation, or failure-mitigation mechanisms that influence it.
determining_elements: "Vehicle braking behavior" identifies the system behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate "Prevent unintended braking."
The straight-ahead, urban-road, 50 km/h, good-weather context with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead matches H-3's operational situation.
"Unintended braking without an obstacle in front" directly corresponds to H-3's hazardous event.
"Normal braking to avoid obstacles" is grounded in FR-7 as the intended counterpart within the braking phenomenon; P does not incorporate obstacle-detection processes or their timing requirements.
